notes: First DQfD run (Hester et al. 2017): 30000 permanent demo transitions built from real wins in the 55050-episode corpus (6821 available), loaded into a 150000-capacity PER buffer (120000 self-play slots), plus a supervised large-margin loss (margin=0.8, weight=1.0) applied to demo rows every batch throughout training - not just at initialization like BC. Cold start (no BC warm-start combined in, to isolate DQfD as its own clean variable). Directly addresses BC's failure mode: run 011 showed the BC prior gets overwritten/forgotten during fine-tuning; DQfD keeps demonstrations permanently in the loop instead. Otherwise our cleanest baseline: Double DQN, soft target updates, n-step=3, PER, raw card encoding, hidden-layers=2, undo allowed, 1000-step episode ceiling.
